title: First-action UI, ritual/store previews and full credit completion: exact scope and superseded gaps

reviews.classification: complete dated UI/ritual/credit checkpoint with later completion and evidence boundaries
reviews.disposition:
All40 lines were read. This independent first-action sample is intermediate evidence on a dirty copied snapshot, not the final L1 floor or a runtime delivery. Live MCP actions and a frozen rebuilt Chrome route have different identities. The14px fresh opening and21px post-action return are not two fresh-life captures. Six existing guidance/report pure tests do not exercise that lead journey. Preserve the missing-Ink snapshot build failure and successful corrected copy separately from an application defect.

The snapshot's one-Tab row focus and automatic Notebook switch were actual observed gaps. Later source edits were described but not browser-tested by this writer; the receipt neither proves their fix nor reproduces a current defect. Source/discovery safety, persistence, waits, story access, final combined inputs and app adoption remain outside its sample. Retain withheld later generated rows and limited screenshots without publishing undiscovered details. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [UI rules](../../../UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and AD42 govern the selected journey. Historical other-worker-active, weekly allowance and L1/L2/L3/L4 order are not current process or dispatch authority; these L1 UI labels also differ from November3's L1 band-data work. No screenshot, manifest, source, live tool/game, test/build/browser, save or worker was newly accessed or run.

reviews.classification: complete dated UI/ritual/credit checkpoint with later completion and evidence boundaries
reviews.disposition:
All40 lines were read. The ritual predicate/principle/substitution model and observed met/substituted/partial/absent bench grades are a preview/hook slice; no Sequence5 dose was consumed or made safer, and its displayed odds were not rolled. The5/90/recovery/feeling-window values, acquisition props and store/mission figures are authored dials, not source-qualified probabilities or universal ritual policy. A transition can require sustained/history support rather than just a final-frame fact. A fitting ritual can fail physically or have different supported outcomes; this local never-a-lock model is not every world's law.

Contribution earned/spent and store bought counters are distinct from items, eligibility and actual institutional rights. Two LOTM assignments, the scoped merit buys and the probe-only sect CP purchase were named browser journeys; fire grass/primer possession still did not implement their use. Cultivation breakthrough and HP Animagus suggestions remained unbuilt. Missing moon, higher ingestion, broader missions/secrecy/heat and incomplete formula material conditions stay exact scope gaps. The3186/3188 pass result with two separately reproduced baseline failures is not a fully green suite; unchanged golden commands and selected migration assertions do not certify all current saves. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [world-pass rules](../../../WORLD_PASS_RULES.md), AD49/AD36/AD43 and optional review govern current claims. No source, ritual result, book/PDF, item, code, JSON, test/build/browser or personal save was newly inspected; branch/no-merge/other-build statements are historical.

reviews.classification: complete dated UI/ritual/credit checkpoint with later completion and evidence boundaries
reviews.disposition:
The complete41-line checkpoint was read, including the later completion round. The initial no-income/no-Repay and imported-calendar-only observations are superseded only for the later actual mission/payment/clock cases. Keep principal, elapsed flat interest, installment progress and total remaining distinct: ten460 installments total4600, principal falls100 per completed installment under authored allocation. That arithmetic is source-context/game modeling, not financial guidance or a universal institution formula. The separate500→680 lender, authored360-day year/600 price/body value and source-cited values retain their different provenance.

The completion implements one8-hour mission and atomic repay, preserving the drop-on-heir policy; a displayed carry dial was not a working serializer and was removed rather than advertising unbuilt behavior. This is a scoped prototype through localhost opt-in, not a general cultivation technique/lineage system. Borrowed formula/curse/primer possession does not establish execution, and priced source acquisition differs from later merit/store consumers. Actual game-clock mission, seeded5000CP payment coverage, literal import on the same origin and one screenshot/computed-font evidence have separate scopes. The second clock-interest increment, full final suite, current rules/combined integration and ordinary life route were not all demonstrated by these records.

The old untracked progression dependency is qualified by B476's later original integration checkpoint; do not claim it still needs landing today or execute old commit/server instructions. The fallback leaf was chosen for concrete disclosure/currency/schedule seams, not because every credit system needs its own database. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [architecture rules](../../../ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), AD38/AD49/AD36/AD43 and AD42 optional review govern actual selection. No source chapters, current code, candidate, browser/test/build, private or personal save, remote or process was newly inspected or modified; no commit/push/install was performed.
